plan: My private value is $25. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. This means bidding $25, which maximizes my potential profit. If I win, I'll pay less than my bid (the third-highest bid), and if I win, I'll gain the difference between my value and the payment. Bidding above my true value risks losing money, while bidding below risks not winning when I could have profitably acquired the item.
